sensor_mast.name: Survey Mast
sensor_mast.blurb: A spine ahead of the keel. You are longer, a little louder, and you see farther.

cargo_blister.name: Cargo Blister
cargo_blister.blurb: A swollen hold on each flank. She carries a real haul and turns like a loaded barge.

gun_sponson.name: Keel Sponson
gun_sponson.blurb: An angular gun cheek. Heavier to yaw. Meaner at the range you already reach.

coil_cannon.name: Coil Cannon
coil_cannon.blurb: A copper-wound spinal, off the centerline so a mast can share the nose. The shot hits harder.

ion_booster.name: Ion Booster
ion_booster.blurb: Aluminum bells on a copper bus. She pushes harder and strafes like she means it.

plate_belt.name: Plated Armor
plate_belt.blurb: Iron plate over wreck-steel. The silhouette thickens. The keel feels every tonne.

shard_lance.name: Shard Lance
shard_lance.blurb: A laced spinal longer than the coil. The shot is heavier, and the nose shows it.

composite_belt.name: Composite Belt
composite_belt.blurb: Resin over alloy. Thicker than iron plate, and the yaw loss is milder.
